name: fe-133
description: Audio Database FOSTER/FOSTEX FE133 Price unknown (1 piece, around 1968) ¥ 3,400 (1 piece, around 1976) Commentary 13 cm cone type full range unit of FE series. Roll edge method is adopted. In consideration of mounting in a small-capacity cabinet, a ferrite magnet is used so that the total height of the speaker is low. There was a model change around 1976 and it was described as FE133New (FE133N) in the catalog. Also, in the picture at that time, the magnetic circuit was changed, and there were 2 kinds of variations of 4 Ω and 8 Ω.
